subject: Request: Article 30 export + evidence metadata for NovaMetrix pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@novametrix.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-05T09:02:00Z
Subject: Request: Article 30 export + DPIA metadata for NovaMetrix pilot

Jordan —

Our privacy team is running a short compliance review in advance of the pilot next month. Can you provide the following so we can complete our intake by 2027-12-15?

1) Art. 30 processing activities export (CSV) scoped to the NovaMetrix pilot (fields: activity_id, purpose, lawful_basis, categories, storage_location, retention_period, subprocessors_count, first_onboarded_at).
2) Latest subprocessor snapshot with onboarding dates and any cross-border transfer mechanisms for APAC.
3) DPIA summary page / risk register export (we only need the summary and mitigations page).
4) Evidence portal metadata for any items you share (SHA256 checksums, s3 paths, evidence portal record IDs).
5) KMS key identifiers and attestation that keys are customer-segregated for the dedicated pool used in our tenant.
6) Sample processing logs (anonymized) for the last 90 days showing data flows and retention enforcement (we'll accept sampled rows).

We have a security audit kickoff scheduled on 2027-12-15 and would like to review the docs internally ahead of that. If anything is restricted or needs an NDA, flag it and we can loop in legal.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation of timeline.

Liam O'Connell
Privacy Lead, NovaMetrix
liam.oconnell@novametrix.com

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@novametrix.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-05T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Article 30 export + DPIA metadata for NovaMetrix pilot

Liam —

Thanks for the detailed list. We can deliver most of this, but a few clarifying points before we start packaging:

- For the Art. 30 export, do you need all revisions (version history) or just the current effective snapshot?
- For sample logs, do you want full request/response traces or only retention/delete event rows? We prefer to provide a sampled, anonymized archive.
- KMS: we can provide the key IDs and a redacted attestation PDF, but full key material is never shared (we'll flag as restricted).

Proposed delivery plan: provisional Art. 30 CSV + subprocessor snapshot by 2027-12-08, DPIA summary + attestation by 2027-12-10, sampled logs in evidence portal by 2027-12-10. If that works we'll open a dedicated evidence bundle in our portal and share an invite.

I'll loop Marissa and Irene to pull the exports and coordinate S3 access. If you want a call to walk through the artifacts, suggest 2027-12-08 morning PT.

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

---
(Attachment: evidence-portal-invite.ics)

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Subject: Fwd: Request: Article 30 export + DPIA metadata for NovaMetrix pilot

Team — forwarding NovaMetrix's ask (see above). Quick tasking:

- Marissa: please produce the Art. 30 snapshot scoped to the pilot and the subprocessor list (include onboarding dates and transfer/legal basis columns). Export as CSV and include a small README for field definitions. Mark any subprocessor rows that rely on SCCs or other safeguards.
- Irene: KMS IDs and redacted attestation + retention enforcement logs (sampled). If logs are sensitive, prepare a hashed checksum file (sha256) and upload sampled archive to evidence portal path under deal-8742.

Timeline: aim for provisional artifacts by 2027-12-08 and final package by 2027-12-10. Put files in the evidence portal and share links back to Liam.

Let me know blockers.

Jordan

Marissa Cole
